name: Hall of Fair Warnings: Read the Signs
read_aloud: Three cheerful signs line the corridor, and each one says TRAP louder than the last. Halfway along, a man in a net turns slowly upside down and waves, which only makes him spin. He calls out that his name is Dale and that you should avoid the square tiles.
narrator_line: Three cheerful signs line the corridor, and each one says TRAP louder than the last.
layout: A clean, well-lit corridor about 100 feet long, caution tape on both walls and a row of ever-louder TRAP signs; Dale Pruitt hangs upside down in a snare net halfway along.

features.name: None worth naming; the hazard is the floor.
Welcome Mat pressure plates and a swinging WET FLOOR sign (check values in 00-overview.md section 5.4).
Ticket, Please turnstile with a hidden needle (poison; section 5.4).
The snare net holding Dale, with a plate right under him.

quick_run.setup: An honest, signed trap hall with a man hanging in a net above a pressure plate.
quick_run.decision: Disarm the plates and get Dale down carefully, or rush through and hope?
quick_run.on_success: Dale is rescued and joins as a helper, and the Crawlers learn saving throws.
quick_run.on_failure: A plate drops Dale or a Crawler; the cost is HP and, at worst, Dale.
quick_run.cut_short: One Perception check for the plates and one check to catch Dale; skip the turnstile.

loot.text: Dale Pruitt, rescued: he tags along and gives Advantage on one check per zone involving vents, doors or machinery (00-overview.md section 5.4).

gm_notes: Strong-model notes stay on the Day page. This stub does not copy if_they_do_something_dumb.
